verdict.rationale: Brex documents REST APIs (transactions, budgets, expenses, payments, webhooks), Postman collections, no-code integrations (Zapier, Pipedream, Workato), and an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence shows official client SDK libraries in any language. Postman collections, OpenAPI reference pages, and the MCP server are adjacent tools or developer building blocks, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit.
